name: infs_sprnbrd
description: Automated testing suite for verifying login functionality using Playwright and Pytest. This dashboard tests a local HTML login page, checking both successful logins and handling failure scenarios (like negative testing) by capturing screenshots automatically on test failure.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold "cd backend && python main.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
